name: Clifford the Big Red Dog
description: The adventures of a larger-than-life red dog on Bridwell Island.

videos.title: My Best Friend
videos.overview: My Best Friend - Believe in yourself Emily decides that she must find something "special" for Show and Tell. But after an exhaustive search of Birdwell Island for the perfect thing to share, Emily learns that sometimes the best things in life are right under your nose.

videos.title: Cleo's Fair Share
videos.overview: Cleo doesn't want to share her new toy with anyone.

videos.title: Special Delivery
videos.overview: Clifford accidentally breaks a present he was supposed to deliver for Emily.

videos.title: A Ferry Tale
videos.overview: Clifford tries to stay clean for a magazine's Dog of the Year contest.

videos.title: And Bird Makes Three
videos.overview: Emily has to take care of a baby bird, leaving her little time to play with Clifford.

videos.title: Home Is Where the Fun Is
videos.overview: Emily is jealous when Jetta gets to visit an exciting city.

videos.title: Clifford's Carnival
videos.overview: Everyone, including Clifford, must work as a team to put on the fall carnival.

videos.title: Clifford's Doggy Reunion
videos.overview: Emily's cousin Laura and her dog, Rex, arrive for a visit.

videos.title: The Great Race
videos.overview: T-Bone finds himself in a race against Mac.

videos.title: Tummy Trouble
videos.overview: When the dogs eat too many treats, they learn that too much of a good thing can be bad.

videos.title: Cleo Comes to Town
videos.overview: In a flashback story, Cleo shakes things up when she arrives on the island.

videos.title: False Friends
videos.overview: When Cleo makes a new friend, she starts ignoring Clifford and T-Bone.

videos.title: Clifford and the Beanstalk
videos.overview: Emily competes against Jetta for the lead in the school play.

videos.title: Itchy Patch
videos.overview: Clifford itches like crazy but hides his discomfort to avoid a trip to the doctor.

videos.title: A New Friend
videos.overview: The new dog in town has only three legs, which makes the gang uncomfortable.

videos.title: Stormy Weather
videos.overview: Clifford's digging talents become an asset when a big storm blows in.

videos.title: Circus Stars
videos.overview: Clifford learns that stars, like everyone else, sometimes need help.

videos.title: Limelight Fright
videos.overview: Cleo develops stage fright when the dogs are recruited to help with a show.

videos.title: To Catch a Bird
videos.overview: All fingers and paws point to Emily as the thief when Jetta's trophy and locket vanish.

videos.title: The Best Party Ever
videos.overview: Jetta mocks Emily's plans for her birthday party activities.

videos.title: Come Back, Mac
videos.overview: When Mac tears one of Jetta's sweaters, he feels terrible about it and runs away.

videos.title: Boo!
videos.overview: Jetta learns that it's OK to have fears and admit them.

videos.title: Little Clifford
videos.overview: In flashbacks, Emily meets Clifford, and her love turns him into the biggest dog around.

videos.title: Welcome to Birdwell Island
videos.overview: Clifford has to dispel preconceived ideas about large dogs.

videos.title: Leaf of Absence
videos.overview: Clifford jumps into a pile of leaves that T-Bone has raked, and when they scatter he has a lesson to learn; Charley finally finds a sport he can't master, “jiggly juggle,” but he decides to work at it anyway.

videos.title: Teacher's Pet
videos.overview: The dogs go to school for the first time, and T-Bone worries that he won't be able to keep up; the library sponsors an essay contest called “Islander of the Year.” Guess who it is?

videos.title: Clifford's Big Surprise
videos.overview: T-Bone's not looking forward to the town celebration because he's afraid of loud noises;  nobody will play with Clifford because they're too busy planning a surprise party for him.

videos.title: Mac's Secret Dog Club
videos.overview: Mac starts an “exclusive” club (he wants to exclude T-Bone); Mr. Bleekman wants to exclude dogs from the park, but he finds that he misses them when they're gone.

videos.title: Fluffed Up Cleo
videos.overview: Cleo is voted Fluffiest Dog of Birdwell Island and can't stop bragging about it; Jetta tells Vaz that he's bad at soccer, which prompts him to stop playing.

videos.title: Good-Bye T-Bone
videos.overview: Clifford and Cleo think that T-Bone is moving; the dogs are upset with the arrival of cats, but then they learn that different isn't necessarily bad.

videos.title: The Truth About Cats and Dogs
The Big Sleepover
videos.overview: Clifford misses Emily when she goes on a trip, so his friends try to make up for it; Charley wants to lead a chore-free dog's life.

videos.title: Dog for a Day
videos.overview: Fed up with his 'responsibilities,' Charley decides he would like to lead a dog's life -- no chores, no school, no problems. But a hilarious dream teaches him that he likes being just who he is.

videos.title: T-Bone, Dog About Town
videos.overview: T-Bone falls in love. Meanwhile, Clifford tries to make the perfect Valentine for Emily.

videos.title: Who Me, Jealous?
videos.overview: Cleo is jealous of her owner's sister's dog, Susie. Also: it's role-reversal time: Clifford, Cleo and T-Bone take care of a pet.

videos.title: Clothes Don't Make the Dog
videos.overview: T-Bone gets a new sweater but learns that “Clothes Don't Make the Dog”; Emily thinks Clifford is neglecting her.

videos.title: The Kibble Crook
videos.overview: T-Bone eats Cleo's new dog food then lies about it; Charley and Emily have an ice-cream party when Charley's father is away.

videos.title: Friends, Morning, Noon and Night
videos.overview: While her house is being painted, Cleo stays with Clifford---and takes over; the dogs try to get grumpy Mr. Bleakman to brighten up, and find that their good deeds make them feel good, too.

videos.title: Doggie Garden
videos.overview: Clifford and the other dogs pitch in with the “Keep Birdwell Island Beautiful” effort by planting a flower garden. Except for Cleo. She wants to plant a dog-toy garden for herself. Then the dogs find the long-buried trunk of  the island's discoverer, Captain Birdwell. But Jetta is given credit for the find. Will she tell the truth? Voice of Clifford: John Ritter.

videos.title: Welcome to the Doghouse
videos.overview: In a flashback sequence, the Howards arrive on Birdwell Island, and their new neighbors join in welcoming a very big newcomer. Then Jetta breaks a beach date with Emily Elizabeth because she has received a “better offer” from an older girl.

videos.title: Clifford's Hiccups
videos.overview: Clifford gets a really big case of the hiccups and his friends have a big job helping him get rid of them; Jetta throws a movie party, but all she shows are home movies of herself.

videos.title: Clifford Cleans His Doghouse
videos.overview: Clifford cleans out his doghouse but can't throw things away because each item holds a memory. Also, Jetta has a new baby brother, but that means that she no longer gets all the attention.

videos.title: Jetta's Tall Tale
videos.overview: Jetta's envious of Emily Elizabeth because everybody loves her pet, Clifford. So she makes up a pet of her own. Then Cleo helps Vaz with his paper route. She likes helping him and she likes the treats she gets as a reward. In fact, she mostly likes the treats.

videos.title: Potluck Party Pooper
videos.overview: Clifford and Emily Elizabeth try to get Mr. Bleakman (voice of Earl Boen), a notorious party pooper, to attend the Howards' party; Emily Elizabeth writes a poem for her mother's birthday, but Jetta thinks it's not a good gift.

videos.title: Two's Company
videos.overview: K.C. returns for a visit and Cleo's so excited that she forgets her other friends. Also, rain threatens the back-to-school barbecue and Mac is so disappointed that his friends try to stop the rain.

videos.title: Topsy Turvy Day
videos.overview: It's Topsy Turvy Day, so Jetta and Emily “trade” dogs. Then Clifford is told to polish his manners for Mrs. Bleakman's book-club party. Voice of Mrs. Bleakman: Edie McClurg.

videos.title: Forgive and Forget
videos.overview: Clifford forgets a play date with Cleo, who accuses him of abusing her friendship; Cleo teases T-bone because he's smitten with a visiting dog named Mimi.

videos.title: Blanket Blues
videos.overview: Cleo borrows Clifford's favorite blanket and carelessly gets it dirty; the dogs dig for dinosaur bones as part of a friend's college project.

videos.title: That's Snow Lie
videos.overview: Cleo Pretends to hurt herself so she won't have to embarrass herself on the ice rink. But with the help of Clifford and his friends, they help her understand that trying new things with your friends is fun.

videos.title: Nothing to Fur But Fur Itself
Fishing Lessons
videos.overview: Emily Elizabeth and Jetta try to get Charley to honor his promises; Cleo runs away to avoid taking a bath.

videos.title: Flood of Imagination
videos.overview: When Cleo's bored by the rain, Clifford gets her to imagine an exciting story; a power failure threatens Birdwell Island, but Clifford and Mr. Bleakman save the day.

videos.title: Led Astray
videos.overview: A visiting dog tries to lead Clifford astray, but he learns to stand up for his beliefs; the kids wonder if marriage will change their teacher.

videos.title: Food For Thought
videos.overview: Ads for a new dog food influence Clifford and his friends; news of an old buddy's upcoming visit makes T-Bone recall his days as a puppy.

videos.title: Tie-Dye Clifford
videos.overview: Clifford accidentally bathes in dye and then tries to hide the fact; Mary's afraid to perform in front of an audience, but is helped by Emily.

videos.title: Doghouse Rock
videos.overview: T-Bone puts together a pop band that Mac would like to join; a dog champion comes to Birdwell Island and all the dogs want to impress him.

videos.title: Little Big Pup
videos.overview: A very small dog named Frankie envies Clifford being big; T-Bone and Clifford have to adjust to their differences in size.

country: United Kingdom, United States, China, France, Taiwan, New Zealand
